title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: We are seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to design, build, and deploy production-grade computer vision and NLP models. The candidate will work closely with backend engineers to containerize ML microservices using Docker and FastAPI, optimize model inference using ONNX, and implement CI/CD pipelines for continuous model monitoring.

title: Data Scientist
description: FinEdge Analytics is looking for a Data Scientist to extract actionable insights and build predictive risk scoring models. You will perform exploratory data analysis, engineer meaningful features from large transactional datasets, build regression and classification models with Scikit-learn and XGBoost, and present strategic recommendations to executive leadership.

title: Full Stack Developer
description: Nexus Cloud Technologies is looking for a versatile Full Stack Developer to build modern cloud-native web applications. Responsibilities include crafting responsive UI components with React and Tailwind CSS, building secure RESTful APIs with Node.js and Express, architecting MongoDB schemas, and integrating third-party authentication services.

title: DevOps & Cloud Engineer
description: ScaleMatrix is looking for a DevOps Engineer to manage scalable cloud infrastructure across AWS environments. You will write Infrastructure-as-Code using Terraform, maintain automated CI/CD deployment pipelines using GitHub Actions, orchestrate container workloads using Kubernetes (EKS), and set up production telemetry using Prometheus and Grafana.

title: Frontend Developer
description: PixelCraft Studio is seeking a passionate Frontend Developer to create intuitive user interfaces for our customer-facing web platform. You will collaborate with UX designers to translate wireframes into interactive React components, optimize web performance and accessibility, and ensure seamless cross-browser responsiveness.

title: Backend Developer (Python / Django)
description: HyperFlow is looking for a Backend Developer to power our high-throughput data processing engine. You will design scalable database schemas with PostgreSQL, implement secure REST APIs using Django REST Framework, manage asynchronous task queues with Celery and Redis, and package services into Docker containers.

title: Data Analyst & BI Specialist
description: RetailPulse Insights is hiring a Data Analyst to build executive business intelligence dashboards and deliver operational reporting. The role requires extracting and cleaning data using complex SQL queries, building interactive Power BI and Tableau dashboards, and performing statistical trend analysis in Python and Excel.

title: Cybersecurity & SOC Analyst
description: CyberShield is seeking a Security Operations Center (SOC) Analyst to monitor, detect, and respond to cyber security incidents. Key duties include analyzing network traffic with Wireshark, configuring SIEM alert rules, conducting vulnerability assessments, and executing incident response protocols to safeguard critical infrastructure.

title: AI & NLP Research Engineer
description: CognitiveAI is developing state-of-the-art Generative AI applications. We are looking for an NLP Research Engineer to build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, fine-tune open-source LLMs using LoRA/QLoRA on Hugging Face and PyTorch, integrate vector databases, and benchmark prompt efficiency.

title: Mobile App Developer (Flutter / React Native)
description: AppVenture Studios is seeking a Mobile App Developer to build smooth cross-platform applications for Android and iOS using Flutter and Dart. You will integrate REST APIs, implement Firebase push notifications and offline caching, collaborate on modern UI animations, and publish builds to app stores.
